title: nematanthus fissus
intro: Nematanthus fissus, commonly known as the "Hanging Goldfish Plant," is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Gesneriaceae family. It is known for its bright green, coin-shaped leaves and vibrant orange flowers that resemble goldfish, hence its common name. The health benefits of Nematanthus fissus include its potential to reduce stress and improve air quality, and it is also believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
